summary.text: Anne Healey is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 22 in Prince George's County, first elected in 1990 and a member of the House since 1991. Her official page lists her as Chair of the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee since 2013.

paragraphs.text: Healey's official page says she was born in Scranton, Pennsylvania, in 1951 and graduated from Cathedral High School in Scranton in 1968.
It lists a B.A. from Marywood College in 1972 and an M.A. from Catholic University in 1974.
It describes her as a writer and editor, reporter and college English instructor, and former newspaper editor at the Catholic Review, the Prince George's Post-Sentinel and the Prince George's Post.
The page lists her as a member of the Environment and Transportation Committee and as President of Women Legislators of Maryland in 2021 and 2022.
It lists her as Chair of the Local Government and Bi-County Agencies Subcommittee of the Environment and Transportation Committee from 2015 to 2025, and as married with two children.
